verdict.rationale: Adyen documents building custom risk rules around business-specific fraud risks. Risk evaluation ends in a block, allow, or review action, with review cases handled by reviewers in the Customer Area. ML scoring and block/allow risk lists exist as separate profile components, but no evidence shows a single custom rule combining model scores, velocity counters, list matches, and attributes. Missing for 10: velocity counters as rule inputs, evidence that model scores and list matches can be combined in custom rule logic, rule-authoring syntax or condition details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
